node_definition.done_when: Repair the regression the merged test-hygiene change (main 872f5cf3b, run r-20261006T031732207059) introduced, found by its independent review: benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py _render_persisted_row now resolves a persisted panel as FIGURE_ROOT / Path(logical).name when no path is given, but tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py's private_root fixture patches only certificate.ROOT, so three of its tests that passed at base fail at head, and the module-level FIGURE_ROOT is also reassigned at runtime by the reposed 500-cell certificate (around line 4356), so the change risks moving those renders too. Done when: (1) _render_persisted_row resolves a persisted panel as ROOT / logical again when no path is given, exactly as at base, keeping the logical-path identity argument the change added to _figure_receipts; (2) tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py::test_rerendered_part_receipt_is_not_a_live_certificate_row confines its render by patching certificate.ROOT to tmp_path (with the part copied under the same relative layout) alongside PART_ROOT and FIGURE_ROOT, so it writes nothing tracked; (3) a durable guard: that test, and tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py::test_grid_imaged_biot_field_converges_to_the_volume_definition, each record the SHA-256 of the tracked files they once wrote (the weak-rotation 300-cell PNG and SVG under docs/figures/gs-absolute-accuracy/solovev, and docs/figures/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov/shafranov-integral/receipt.json) before running and assert them unchanged after, so a reintroduced tracked write fails the test; (4) tests/test_figure_panel_pin.py, tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py, tests/test_certificate_pin.py and tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py run in ONE process pass by delta against main at dispatch (the one pre-existing failure test_pinned_certificate_refuses_unqualified_production_rows excepted and named), and git status shows no tracked file changed afterwards; (5) negative control: the guard of item (3), run once against the unrepaired renderer from a scratch copy under the run directory, fails naming the changed file. Every uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync; these modules run in seconds, so the login node is acceptable with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv and PYTHONPATH set to the run worktree (orientation_worktree in the manifest); record baseline_suite and after_suite with module-qualified failure ids; commit with a conventional subject and a body; the manifest commits line lists every commit.
